open_points.subject: MigrationClosure scope and identity
open_points.text: “it is a fact about the instance” conflicts with “at most one per store history” and “an instance that restores a store from before the import may import again, and that history then holds its own closure.”
open_points.question: Is MigrationClosure a fact scoped to the Registry instance across restores, or separately to each store history created by a restore?
options: One closure per instance, surviving or otherwise governing all restored histories
One closure per store history, so the same instance may acquire another closure after restoring a pre-import backup
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as one closure per store history, because R0-89 explicitly narrows R0-79 and the changed lifecycle and persistence passages say so.
